answer: In the AI agent economy, each agent must deposit 10 quartz in a vault upon joining. Quartz is released linearly over 100 days for verified tasks; if an agent is exposed as fake, all quartz are forfeited. An attacker running 100 fake identities must initially lock 1000 quartz and risks losing all if any are exposed. The oasis protocol caps refunds at 10 quartz daily per identity, preventing rapid exit after fraud.
